title: Zeros or X-Intercepts
text: The numerator is the nonzero constant $$3$$, so the function can never equal $$0$$.

title: Domain
text: Because $$x^2+4$$ is positive for every real $$x$$, the denominator is never zero and the domain is all real numbers.

title: Range
text: The denominator is smallest at $$x=0$$, giving the maximum $$f(0)=\frac{3}{4}$$. As $$|x|$$ grows, f(x) approaches $$0$$ but never reaches it.
